howto.name: Upload SVG images
howto.text: Drop one or many .svg files. Vector content scales infinitely.

howto.name: Choose page size
howto.text: Letter or A4. Each SVG scales proportionally to fit while preserving aspect ratio.

howto.name: Download the PDF
howto.text: All SVGs become one PDF, one per page. Vector content stays vector — no rasterization.

faq.q: Will my SVG stay as vector inside the PDF?
faq.a: Yes — PDF natively supports vector content, so paths, text, and gradients remain editable at any zoom level.

faq.q: What about embedded raster images inside SVG?
faq.a: Embedded raster images (data URLs, external image refs) are preserved as raster within the PDF.

faq.q: Does it handle CSS styles inside SVG?
faq.a: Standard SVG CSS (fill, stroke, opacity, transform) is honored. External stylesheet refs are inlined first.
